relevant_points: Altermagnetism is a distinct collinear-compensated magnetic phase
Key signatures include spin-split bands without net magnetization and d/g/i-wave anisotropy patterns
Materials can span metals and insulators
Spin-space symmetries offer a systematic route to classify magnetic structures
Symmetry-derived features can explain unconventional Fermi-surface textures and degeneracies

papers.topic: Extended altermagnetism in non-collinear chiral systems
relevant_points: Confirms broadening of altermagnetic concept beyond simple collinear settings
Emphasizes multipolar and transport signatures not available from the current dataset alone
A useful AI-discovery framing includes interpretable descriptors, uncertainty-aware ranking, and expert-guided validation
Transferability and clear candidate prioritization are important in materials-search systems

contract_updates: Report should distinguish predictive screening from first-principles confirmation.
Where direct physical classes such as metal/insulator or d/g/i-wave are unavailable from provided data, avoid unsupported claims.
Candidate prioritization and class-imbalance-aware evaluation are central artifacts.
